exposure: iatrogenic rupture of the intertwin membranes
laser surgery for twin-to-twin transfusion syndrome (TTTS)
cohort: 338 pregnancies of twins with and without iatrogenic rupture of the intertwin membranes that had been treated for TTTS with laser surgery
finding: Iatrogenic rupture of intertwin membranes was suspected in 20% of pregnancies treated with laser therapy for TTTS and was associated with a lower gestational age at birth and increased neonatal morbidity.
mod_finding: Preterm Cesarean section was performed for monoamnionicity in 70% of cases where iatrogenic rupture of the intertwin membranes was suspected antenatally.
